MRM25v2.0

The MRM25v2.0 model was prepared for th2 2026-2035 N.C. Department of Transportation’s State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP). The STIP identifies the construction funding and schedule for state transportation projects over a 10-year period. NCDOT updates the STIP approximately every two years.

As of June 2025, MRM25v2.0 is being reviewed by N.C. Department of Environmental Quality (NC DEQ). The projects represented in the MRM for this model version are described below.

Model Area

The model area covers a twelve county, bi-state region. In North Carolina, all of Cabarrus, Cleveland, Gaston, Iredell, Lincoln, Mecklenburg, Rowan, Stanly, and Union Counties are included. In South Carolina, all of York County and the northern panhandle of Lancaster County are included. This represents an expansion of the previous model area to include the area of Iredell County north of the Yadkin River. In addition, staff opted to include the southeast corner of Catawba County to capture travel patterns along NC 150 and in the Lake Norman area in general. Figure 1 1 shows the area included in the Metrolina Model.

Surveys and Studies

MRM22v2.0 builds on the major model update process undertaken with the 2010 Census that included the collection of new travel behavior data as well as building on previously collected data. Tour frequency, destination choice, and time of day models are calibrated based on data collected in the 2012 Household Travel Survey. The mode choice component of the model is calibrated based on data collected in the 2012 Household Travel Survey and the 2013 Transit On-Board Survey.

Model Years

The official base year validation of MRM22v2.0 is 2018. MTP-based forecast years include 2025, 2035, 2045, and 2050. For conformity, the budget year 2026 was also modeled.

Highway Networks

MRM22v2.0 was validated to the year 2018. Future year highway and transit networks for 2025, 2035, 2045, and 2050 were created for the long-range planning efforts. Projects included in the future year networks are based on the financially constrained Metropolitan Transportation Plans (MTP) for each of the respective MPOs. Highway projects in non-MPO (RPO) were added ONLY if they were included in their respective NC or SC Transportation Improvement Plans (TIP) documents. Financial constraint calculations and project selection criteria can be found in the respective MTP documents:

Highway Projects

The MRM is a regional model. All projects are included where practical and possible. Projects that do not add capacity, are minor intersection improvements, or are small widenings on non-regionally significant roadways may be below the scope of the model and omitted from analysis. All regionally significant projects are included.

Model projects are referenced by the project index number. A project is selected for a particular model year by index number. Project characteristics (e.g., lanes, facility type, intersection controls) are added to the network before capacities and speeds are estimated. The tables below are grouped by county and sorted by the year the project is to open to traffic. TIP numbers are included where possible. Some projects cross county and MPO boundaries; these are included at the end of one of the county lists.
